$note: Behavioral routing eval of think-framework-advisor (SP1 C2, agent-executed). A periodic MEASUREMENT, not a gate: judged by an LLM, so the number is model-dependent and small-N. The enforced every-PR gate is the static eval-cases validator (scripts/eval-cases.mjs).
method: Each of the advisor's 12 authored eval/cases.md cases was applied by one agent (acting as the advisor, reading its SKILL.md + recommendable.md) and independently scored by a second agent against the case expectation, name-safety, and the output-checks.
